title: Retry Health Gate Guidance
content:
Retry and retrigger requests for failed workflows must not run blindly. Before retrying a failure that may involve Life Asia or TEBT, first inspect the latest failed execution evidence, classify the related application, and validate the related health check. Run that health check only when the user is asking to retry, restart, resubmit, or retrigger. Do not run the application health check during a simple status-only request. If the health check is down, block the retry. If the health check is healthy, communicate that clearly and continue.

Preferred diagnostic entry point: check_workflow_status for the affected workflow or request.

Required user-facing style: business-friendly, short, and action-oriented.
